comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PLAN ACCEPTED. Search linked Story choices by Key and name, preserving existing finder ranking and ordinary select behavior. Shared fuzzy helper plus opt-in generic searchable field is appropriate; keep selected Story Key separate from query and preserve draft edits. Cover create/edit and separate add-link form with same Board/self-link restrictions. Ensure Enter chooses the candidate without accidentally submitting the whole form; Escape restores/cancels query appropriately, clear/no-results states intentional, key capture/footer agree. Follow TUI design tokens/one-component-per-file/barrels. New/changed Plugin API docs examples must update compiled fixture regions in same change; no new tests by default, extend required existing doc/architecture contracts only. Manual fuzzy/no-results/selection/draft/persistedrelationship checks, agentic-tui screenshots, allfourchecks, draft PR/normal push, no .rowbly changes. Keep scope to linked Story search, not unrelated Form redesign.
